nodes.scope: Rejected operand-stack experiment: higher instruction counts in five of six inputs; raw results retained.

scope: Instruction diagnostics on identical frozen inputs. All three profiled outputs validate twice per point. Raw self profiles and source-input identities retained. Neither instruction reductions nor embedded single-sample timings establish native Boa speed qualification. Full correctness and two independent hosted speed gates remain separate requirements. Fourth point is a rejected bounded environment-root cache; its adverse invalid-result profile remains recorded and the runtime change is reverted. Native-error and native-step points retain their original diagnostics. Native-step validates all six frozen inputs twice; these remain instruction counts, not hosted Boa speed qualification. Auxiliary-stack and short-function points retain all six unchanged inputs and do not establish native qualification. Stable-slot LRU reduces invalid-result instructions but slightly increases the other five; all six observations are retained without claiming native qualification. Outlined short-ASCII construction improves four instruction profiles and increases captured-next and done/value; all six unchanged observations remain recorded. Deferred AST array allocation retains all six fixed observations; this is a new runtime source and does not inherit prior native qualification. Owned-site function memoization retains all six diagnostic observations with pinned immutable syntax owners; this does not establish native speed qualification. Weak-environment hints are rootless per-stored-edge facade hints, distinct from the rejected strong activation environment cache. All six unchanged diagnostics validate twice; native qualification remains separate. Fresh literal-accessor initialization reduces done/value instructions but increases invalid-result instructions by0.18%; all six observations remain retained without native qualification.
